test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 5

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 8.5 years at 16% per annum rate of interest.
Kalpana and Sudha got 624 and 598 marks, respectively, in the same examination. If Kalpana scored 24% marks, then what is the percentage of marks scored by Sudha?
A trader marks his goods at 43% above the cost price and allows a discount of 10% on them. If he still makes a profit of x%, then the value of x is:
A bus is moving at a speed of 79 km/h. If its speed is reduced by 53%, then the new speed of the bus (in km/h) will be:
Two students appeared in an examination. One of them secured 14 marks more than the other and his marks were 60% of the sum of their marks. The sum of the marks obtained by them was:

A started a business with a capital of ₹1,38,000. After 4 months, B joined him with a certain amount of capital. At the end of a year of A's starting the business, the profit was shared in the ratio 2 : 1. How much (in ₹) did B invest?

Arvind bought an article for ₹x. He sold it to Biru at a loss of 30%. Biru spent ₹113 on its transportation and sold it to Minu at a profit of 38%. If Minu bought it for ₹1518, then what is the value of x?
The two diagonals and one side of a parallelogram are 8 cm, 14 cm and 9 cm, respectively. What is the perimeter of the parallelogram?

X and Y, working separately can do a piece of work in 14 and 21 days, respectively. If they work on alternate days beginning with X, and get paid ₹45 per day, then find the amount received by X after the completion of work.

Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 3 hours, and pipe C can fill the same tank in 2 hours. The time taken (in hours) by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is:

One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 41 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 17 km/hr, and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 18 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to 1 decimal place) for the entire journey is:

A retailer allows a trade discount of 40%, followed by a cash discount of 15% on the price to have been paid after the trade discount. If a customer paid ₹1,530 for an article, then how much was the cash discount (in ₹)?
The average of the marks of 13 students in a class is 58. If the marks of each student are doubled, then find the new average.
Virat invested ₹90,000 at 18% p.a. for 1 year at compound interest, compounded half-yearly. The amount received by him is:
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹5,235. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, then the price (in ₹) of the costliest item is:
The average of three numbers is 20. If two numbers are 12 and 28, the third number is:

Salil invested ₹58,500 in a bank. In two years, how much compound interest (in ₹) will he get considering annual compounding, if the first year rate of interest was 8% per annum and second year had 2% per annum more than first year?

In a library, the ratio of number of story books to that of non-story books was 4:1, and total number of story books was 1224. When some more story books were bought, the ratio became 13:1. Find the number of story books bought.
The LCM of the numbers 14, 65 and 89 is:
During the festive season, a shopkeeper announces a special offer: “Buy 12 crackers and get 3 crackers free”. What is the effective discount percentage under this scheme?
